input.summary: Plunge B, collect A, and test the lit return lanes. Use controlled alley passes to build 5x and 29,000 base bonus. Enter lit saucer 2 to collect 145,000, reset base bonus, and preserve 5x for another cycle.

quickInfo.name: A-B
quickInfo.summary: A and B light opposite inlanes and outlanes for 5,000, a bonus advance, and one Bonus X advance.

quickInfo.name: Scores Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Lit saucer 2 collects base bonus with Bonus X, resets base bonus, and preserves the multiplier.

quickInfo.name: Green drop
quickInfo.summary: A moving green lamp makes one right-bank target worth 10,000 and one Bonus X advance.

quickInfo.name: Lit Spinner
quickInfo.summary: Completing the five-bank lights the spinner for 1,000 and one bonus advance per spin.

quickInfo.name: Maximum bonus
quickInfo.summary: Base bonus reaches 29,000 and Bonus X reaches 5x for a 145,000 collect.

steps.text: Plunge the top B lane. Try to let its exit bounce into the right-side A lane.
modeNotes: A-B: A lights the left outlane and right inlane. B lights the left inlane and right outlane.
A lit bottom lane scores 5,000, adds one base-bonus advance, and raises Bonus X once.

steps.text: Control the ball. Test one alley pass through a lit inlane.
If the pass is controlled, repeat it between the two inlanes.
modeNotes: Bonus X: Lit bottom lanes, green right-bank targets, and a qualified three-bank completion raise this multiplier to 5x.
Base bonus reaches 29,000. Neither base bonus nor Bonus X carries after the ball.

steps.text: Continue until Bonus X reaches 5x and base bonus reaches 29,000.
Read saucer 2. It lights after base bonus reaches 20,000 or all three saucers are unlit.
modeNotes: Scores Bonus: Lit saucer 2 scores the full multiplied bonus. It resets base bonus and preserves Bonus X.
Each saucer adds one bonus advance. A lit saucer scores 5,000 and becomes unlit. An unlit saucer scores 500.
Unlighting all three relights them, adds one green right-bank lamp, and lights Scores Bonus.

steps.text: Send the ball through the spinner or upper lanes toward saucer 2.
Enter lit saucer 2 to collect up to 145,000.
Rebuild base bonus while 5x remains active. Repeat Scores Bonus on the same ball.

fallback.title: Recovery: Up-top bonus route
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this when the alley pass arcs out of control or the inlane switches do not register reliably.

steps.text: Shoot the left orbit from the right flipper.
From the left flipper, bank the ball from the right-side drop targets toward the top.
Collect A and B at top and side lanes.
Hit only a right-bank target with a green lamp for one Bonus X advance.
Complete the center three-bank after the top standup qualifies its multiplier award.
At 20,000 base bonus, read saucer 2.
Collect Scores Bonus when its upper feed remains controlled.

alternatives.title: Position play: Five-bank spinner route
alternatives.when: When trailing, use this higher-ceiling route: use this when the right-bank rebounds and spinner return are controlled.

steps.text: Hit a green-lit target in the right five-bank.
modeNotes: Green drop: Each right-bank target scores 3,000 and adds one bonus advance. A green target scores 10,000 and raises Bonus X.

steps.text: Pop-bumper hits move the green lamp. A 1-2-3 saucer completion adds another green lamp.
Complete the five-bank.
modeNotes: Lit Spinner: The completion lights 1,000 and one bonus advance per spin. It also resets both drop banks.
Extra Ball: The completion makes the center three-bank alternate between lit and unlit Extra Ball states with bumper hits.

steps.text: Shoot the spinner to rebuild base bonus after a Scores Bonus collect.
Complete the center bank only while its Extra Ball lamp is lit.

alternatives.title: Top-standup sequence
alternatives.when: Use this only after the direct target rebound is known.

steps.text: Hit the top center standup once.
modeNotes: Multi-Bonus: The first hit makes each A-B lane add five base-bonus advances.

steps.text: Hit it a second time to qualify a Bonus X advance at the center three-bank.
Complete the three-bank for that multiplier advance.
A third top-standup hit lights Special at the left standup for this ball.
Stop after a center-directed rebound.

alternatives.title: A-B Extra Ball
alternatives.when: Use this when A-B is complete and Extra Ball has tournament value.

steps.text: Complete both A and B.
Watch the moving green lamp on the right five-bank.
When the center target is green, it also lights for Extra Ball.
Hit that target to collect the award.
Competition settings can replace Extra Ball and Special with 50,000 or disable both.
Collect A and B.
Use controlled lit-inlane passes to reach 5x and 29,000.
Enter lit saucer 2 for 145,000.
Keep 5x and rebuild base bonus.
Collect saucer 2 again on the same ball.

playfieldReferences.label: Bonus collect saucer 2
playfieldReferences.description: Lit saucer used to collect multiplied base bonus.
playfieldReferences.context: Enter lit saucer 2 after building base bonus and 5x.

techniques.name: Shatz pass
techniques.instruction: Pass the ball through a lit inlane to the opposite flipper. Repeat only while the arc stays controlled.

techniques.name: Right-flipper left orbit
techniques.instruction: Use the right flipper to send the ball through the left orbit toward the top lanes.

techniques.name: Right-bank rebound
techniques.instruction: From the left flipper, bank the ball from the right drop targets toward the top instead of driving them squarely.

cautions.issue: An alley pass can arc above the return lane and lose control.
cautions.response: Test one pass before repetition. Stop when the arc reaches the upper playfield.

cautions.issue: Target rebounds and upper-right returns can reach the center drain.
cautions.response: Prefer green targets and bank shots. Keep both lower flippers ready for upper returns.

input.simpleOverview: The Amazing Spider-Man is a multiplier, bonus, and saucer-collect game. Use controlled passes through the lit inlanes to reach 5x and build base bonus, then send the ball to lit saucer 2 to collect the multiplied value and keep 5x for another cycle.
input.overview: The Amazing Spider-Man is a multiplier, bonus, and saucer-collect game. Reach both values, enter lit saucer 2 for the Scores Bonus collect, then rebuild the base bonus while 5x remains active. Repeat only while the inlane pass and upper feed stay controlled.
